blocker: The historical reprocess and LINE Streamlit UI tests are absent. Retained order API tests and current React client/store tests cover partial error, retry identity and receipt contracts, but no verified current UI test in this binding asserts queued-to-succeeded rendering. These partial runners do not establish complete coverage of the unchanged acceptance criteria.

root_facts: Typed HTTP responses for unauthorized, forbidden, conflict and unavailable outcomes.
A lost-response unavailable error, an idempotency identity and a durable job status response.
forbidden_direct_seed: UI decision, typed transport category, retry identity or completed job display
commands: Map typed server errors through the UI transport client.
Retry an unavailable apply with unchanged operation state and refresh the durable job status.
Map a database contention and stale version error through the order API boundary.
expected: Typed clients preserve category, code and correlation identity without branching on human message text.
Unavailable retry reuses the original idempotency key; changed UI input does not silently alter the retry command.
The UI displays queued work before it displays completion, while contention is HTTP 503 and stale version is HTTP 409.
